shots.desc: Short orbit over the page: a flat-roofed house on the left full of people, a lake and a boat on the right. Inside, Jesus is talking; people crowd round the door.
Low and close, under the roof: Jesus talks warmly to the crowd; Peter beside the door nods along.
Four friends come along the road carrying a man on a mat: two hold the mat's poles, two lead the way. They put him down to rest on the road in front of the house.
At the side door: a wall of backs. friend3 tries to squeeze through and bounces back. They all stop and think.
friend3 and friend4 lead the way up the outside stair onto the flat roof; friend1 and friend2 lift the man and carry him along the road to the foot of the stair.
On the flat roof: the man lies on his mat behind the patch; friend1 and friend2 kneel either side and dig, friend3 and friend4 cheer them on from the front corners. Clods and dust fly.
Inside: crumbs and dust trickle down onto Peter's head. A patch of sky opens in the ceiling. Peter clutches his head; Jesus looks up and smiles.

Down from the ceiling the mat comes on four ropes, slowly swinging, until the man lies right in front of Jesus. The camera stays above the ceiling's height, so the ropes vanish into the roof edge (the hole is narrower than the mat, PLAN.md).
Jesus looks up at the four faces in the hole, then down at the man, and kneels beside him.
He rolls up his mat, slings it on his shoulder and dances out of the house to the front of the page; the friends jump and cheer on the roof; the crowd gasps.
Evening on the lake. Peter's boat with Jesus and Peter aboard, Peter at the steering oar. Jesus, tired, lies down with His head on the cushion at the back and falls asleep.
Dark sky, rain, wind, waves splashing into the boat. Peter heaves at the oar, then bails with a bucket. Jesus sleeps on.
Close on the stern: Jesus is still asleep in the rain. Peter stumbles over and shakes Him.
Jesus wakes, stands up in the rain at the stern and stretches out His arms over the water. The wind stops, the rain stops, the lake goes flat as glass; stars come out.
Peter, soaked, stares at the quiet lake and back at Jesus.
Morning: the whole page from the front. Jesus and Peter on the beach; the healed man comes skipping along the road with his rolled mat on his shoulder and waves. Golden light.

lines.zh: 耶稣来到迦百农，住在彼得家。大家听说了，一下子全挤来了，屋里屋外都是人！
lines.en: Jesus came to the town of Capernaum and stayed at Peter's house. Everyone heard, and they all squeezed in. People inside, people outside, people everywhere!
lines.dir: storyteller opening, bright; speed up and pile on 屋里屋外都是人 / 'people everywhere'

lines.zh: 上帝爱你们每一个人。他的国，就在你们中间。
lines.en: God loves every one of you. His kingdom is right here among you.
lines.dir: warm and simple, smiling at the people; not preachy

lines.zh: 这时候，路上来了四个好朋友，抬着一个人。这个人的腿不能走路，只能天天躺在褥子上。
lines.en: Just then, four good friends came down the road, carrying a man. His legs couldn't walk, so every day he had to lie on his mat.
lines.dir: warm, a little tender on 只能天天躺在褥子上 / 'every day he had to lie'

lines.zh: 加油！耶稣一定能帮你！
lines.en: Come on, we're nearly there! Jesus can help you, I know He can!
lines.dir: bright, panting a little from carrying; total certainty in 一定 / 'I know He can'

lines.zh: 谢谢你们……我好紧张呀。
lines.en: Thank you, friends... I'm so nervous.
lines.dir: small, shy, a nervous little laugh

lines.zh: 请让一让！让一让——哎哟！
lines.en: Excuse me! Excuse me, please... oof!
lines.dir: polite and hopeful, then a comic 'oof' as he bounces off the crowd

lines.zh: 别挤啦！进不去啦！
lines.en: No pushing! There's no room!
lines.dir: crowd of 8-10, grumbly but not nasty, overlapping

lines.zh: 嗯……门进不去……
lines.en: Hmm... we can't get in the door...
lines.dir: big slow friend, thinking out loud, long 嗯 / 'hmm'

lines.zh: 有了！我们从屋顶下去！
lines.en: I've got it! We'll go in through the roof!
lines.dir: sudden bright idea, finger up; a little gasp before 有了 / 'I've got it'

lines.zh: 他们抬着朋友，一步一步爬上了屋顶。那时候的屋顶是平的，用木头、树枝和泥土铺成。
lines.en: Step by step, they carried their friend up onto the roof. In those days roofs were flat, made of wood, branches and mud.
lines.dir: steady, a bit breathless with them on 一步一步 / 'step by step'; then explaining, friendly

lines.zh: 挖呀挖，挖呀挖！
lines.en: Dig, dig, dig! Dig, dig, dig!
lines.dir: the four friends together, a cheerful work chant, rhythmic

lines.zh: 哎！哎哎哎！我的屋顶！
lines.en: Hey! Hey, hey, HEY! My roof!
lines.dir: big comic panic; rising 哎 three times; 我的屋顶 / 'My roof!' almost a wail, funny

lines.zh: 哈哈，彼得，你看——有人来了。
lines.en: Ha ha! Peter, look... someone's coming.
lines.dir: amused, warm chuckle; gentle teasing to Peter; curious on 有人来了 / 'someone's coming'

lines.zh: 他们在屋顶上挖了一个洞，用绳子把褥子慢慢地、慢慢地放下来，正好放在耶稣面前。
lines.en: They made a hole in the roof, and with ropes they let the mat down... slowly... slowly... right in front of Jesus.
lines.dir: hushed and suspenseful; stretch 慢慢地、慢慢地 / 'slowly... slowly'; land softly on 耶稣面前

lines.zh: 耶稣抬头看见四个朋友，知道他们真的相信他。
lines.en: Jesus looked up at the four friends, and He saw how much they trusted Him.
lines.dir: warm and slow; a small smile in the voice on 真的相信 / 'trusted Him'

lines.zh: 孩子，你的罪赦免了。
lines.en: Son, your sins are forgiven.
lines.dir: very tender, close, like a father; unhurried

lines.zh: 有人在心里嘀咕：只有上帝才能赦罪啊！耶稣知道他们在想什么。
lines.en: Some people grumbled inside: only God can forgive sins! Jesus knew what they were thinking.
lines.dir: a touch of mystery on the grumble (lower voice), then plain

lines.zh: 为了让你们知道，我有赦罪的权柄——
lines.en: So that you will know I have the power to forgive sins...
lines.dir: calm, clear, to the whole room; a pause at the dash

lines.zh: 起来！拿起你的褥子，回家去吧！
lines.en: Get up! Pick up your mat, and go home!
lines.dir: joyful command, bright and strong, a smile in it; not shouted

lines.zh: 我……我的腿……我站起来了！我能走了！
lines.en: My... my legs... I'm standing! I can walk!
lines.dir: disbelief to laughter: stammer, a gasp, then pure joy on 我能走了 / 'I can walk!'

lines.zh: 哇！我们从来没见过这样的事！
lines.en: Wow! We have never seen anything like this!
lines.dir: crowd of 8-10, amazed, overlapping gasps and a child's 哇

lines.zh: 大家都很惊奇，一起赞美上帝。
lines.en: Everyone was amazed, and they all praised God.
lines.dir: warm and glowing

lines.zh: 好吧好吧——这个洞，挖得值！
lines.en: All right, all right... that hole was worth it!
lines.dir: big hearty laugh first, then shaking his head, delighted

lines.zh: 那天傍晚，耶稣对门徒说：我们到湖对岸去吧。他们就上了彼得的船。
lines.en: That evening, Jesus said to His friends: let's go across to the other side of the lake. So they got into Peter's boat.
lines.dir: calm, evening voice, a gentle lilt like the water

lines.zh: 耶稣忙了一整天，累了，枕着一个枕头，在船尾睡着了。
lines.en: Jesus had been busy all day. He was tired, so He lay down on a cushion at the back of the boat and fell asleep.
lines.dir: soft, sleepy, smiling

lines.zh: 忽然，起了一阵大风暴！浪一个接一个打进船里，船里的水都快满了！
lines.en: Suddenly a huge storm came! Wave after wave crashed into the boat, and it was filling up with water!
lines.dir: exciting, faster, a little breathless; big on 大风暴 / 'huge storm'

lines.zh: 舀水！快舀水！不行啦，水太多啦！
lines.en: Bail! Bail faster! It's no good, there's too much water!
lines.dir: comic panic, shouting over the wind, breathless; voice cracks on 不行啦 / 'no good'

lines.zh: 老师！老师，快醒醒！我们快要沉下去了，你不管我们吗？
lines.en: Teacher! Teacher, wake up! We're going to sink! Don't you care about us?
lines.dir: frantic, shaking Him; the last question hurt and scared, not angry

lines.zh: 风，停下来！浪，安静吧！
lines.en: Wind, stop! Waves... be still!
lines.dir: firm and strong but not angry; a small pause before 安静吧 / 'be still', then soft

lines.zh: 你们为什么害怕呢？还不相信我吗？
lines.en: Why were you so afraid? Do you still not trust Me?
lines.dir: very gentle, a small smile, like a friend; not a telling-off

lines.zh: 他到底是谁？连风和浪都听他的话！
lines.en: Who is this? Even the wind and the waves do what He says!
lines.dir: awed whisper to himself, then louder with wonder on 连风和浪 / 'even the wind'

lines.zh: 变魔术，是骗眼睛的。耶稣行的是真正的神迹：他让我们知道，他爱我们，也有能力帮助我们。
lines.en: A magic trick fools your eyes. But Jesus did real miracles. They show us that He loves us, and He is able to help us.
lines.dir: warm moral, straight to the child; slow and clear on the last sentence

lines.zh: 就像那四个好朋友，我们也可以把需要帮助的人，带到耶稣面前。
lines.en: And just like the four good friends, we can bring people who need help to Jesus too.
lines.dir: encouraging, a smile; lift on 四个好朋友 / 'four good friends'
